external_email.needed: A configured working mail transport and a user-designated test mailbox with inbox access; local mail-log tests do not establish external delivery.

payments.needed: A specified payment provider, sandbox merchant credentials, supported success/failure/cancel/refund scenarios, and a reachable verified webhook endpoint. Current GCash flow records manual payment proof; it does not establish provider charging or refunds.

google_sign_in.needed: A designated Google test account and a permitted callback URL for end-to-end sign-in.
